en.cancel_none: There is no request from you to cancel in this conversation.
en.completed_empty: The request completed without a text response.
en.effect_unknown: The request stopped with an uncertain outcome. It was not retried.
en.failed: The request could not be completed.
en.interaction_invalid_answer: That response does not match the requested format. Review the prompt and reply again.
en.interaction_secret_ask_user: SoAI needs a private response. Open the secure Chat prompt: {url}
en.interaction_secure_chat_required: For security, submit this secret through the secure Chat prompt instead.
en.interaction_stale_answer: That interaction is no longer pending. Review the latest SoAI prompt before replying.
en.interaction_tool_approval: SoAI wants to run {tool}. Reply yes/y, no/n, or always and include token {token}.
en.interaction_vault_secret: SoAI needs a credential. Submit it through the secure Chat prompt: {url}
en.new_completed: New SoAI conversation started. Earlier messages remain here but are no longer part of the assistant's context.
en.status_idle: There is no active request in this conversation.
en.status_input_required: The current request is waiting for your response.
